content.name: Émilie Gagnon
content.title: HR Generalist, CHRP
content.summary: Bilingual (English/French) HR generalist with eight years in hospitality, technology and the non-profit sector. Supports 520 employees at a national charity, holds the CHRP designation, and rebuilt the performance review process so completion rose from 58% to 96%.

experience.title: HR Generalist
bullets: Provide HR advice in English and French to 520 employees and 45 people leaders across Ontario and Québec.
Replaced a paper performance review with a two-step check-in in BambooHR, raising completion from 58% to 96%.
Updated policies for Ontario ESA changes, including the right-to-disconnect and electronic monitoring policies.
Manage WSIB and CNESST claims and return-to-work plans, closing 18 claims in 2025.

experience.title: HR Advisor
bullets: Supported a tech company as it grew from 140 to 310 employees, including two acquisitions.
Harmonized benefits and vacation policies for 75 employees joining through acquisitions.
Coached managers through 30 performance improvement plans, with two-thirds ending in successful improvement.
Launched an employee engagement survey and action-planning sessions; the response rate reached 84%.

experience.title: HR Assistant
bullets: Processed payroll changes and new hire paperwork for 260 hotel and restaurant staff.
Organized seasonal hiring fairs that filled 70 summer positions.
Kept AODA and WHMIS training records up to date for the Ottawa properties.

education.degree: Bachelor of Commerce, Human Resource Management
education.school: University of Ottawa, Telfer School of Management
education.details: Co-op program; studied in French and English

achievements.title: Review completion 58% to 96%
achievements.detail: New performance check-in process at Rideau Care Foundation.

achievements.title: Integrated two acquisitions
achievements.detail: Harmonized policies and benefits for 75 employees at ByWard Software.
